headline: The Engineering Difference Between Made-to-Measure and AI Bespoke: Why They Are Not the Same Process
description: This article establishes the engineering distinction between Made-to-Measure (MTM) and AI Bespoke, explaining that MTM is a local adjustment of an existing master pattern while AI Bespoke is a geometric compilation from scratch. It presents AETERNAL's framework as a third paradigm that uses mandatory mathematical constants and dynamic functions to strip the master pattern of its dimensional decision-making authority.
keywords: Made-to-Measure, AI Bespoke, Computational Pattern Engineering, Zero-Baseline Calculation, Deterministic Conflict Matrix, SAR Index, Parametric System Engine, garment engineering, non-linear computation, biometric data
